# Dr. Aditi Jain – Assistant Professor, Obstetrician & Gynaecologist

> Dr. Aditi Jain is an Assistant Professor of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Infertility Specialist, and Gynae Laparoscopic Surgeon practicing in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## Core Services & Areas of Care
- **Infertility Evaluation & Treatment**: Pre-conception checks, follicular monitoring, ovulation induction, ovarian reserve testing.
- **Gynae Laparoscopic Surgery**: Minimally invasive laparoscopic procedures for ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, endometriosis, and tubal evaluation.
- **High-Risk Obstetrics & Antenatal Care**: Maternal monitoring, gestational diabetes, hypertension control, prenatal scans.
- **PCOS/PCOD & Hormonal Management**: Evidence-based ovulation restoration, lifestyle protocol, metabolic care.
- **Women's Preventive Healthcare**: Cervical cancer screening (Pap Smear), HPV vaccination, mammography referrals.
- **Telemedicine / Online Consultations**: Secure video consultations via Google Meet for report reviews and follow-ups.
